ph.title: Change phone number
ph.p: We send a code to the new number. After the change, your other devices are signed out and earlier orders stay under the old number.
ph.send: Send code to the new number
ph.sent: Code sent to the new number.
ph.same: This is already your account's number.
ph.again: Verification timed out — ask for a new code.
err.phone_taken: This number has its own account. To use it, sign out here and sign in with that number.
